scopeRule: Comparison points are the operations a user calls. An exception class is a failure signal rather than an operation, and a module-level constant is configuration, so both are excluded and both stay counted. Class members such as socket.socket.recv are recorded because that is where most of a module's real surface lives; builtins is excluded from that flattening because its classes are the primitive types, which have containers already. Only a class's methods count; its data attributes are fields.
title: Python comparison surface
